For each test instance, we provide the judges with supporting speeches along with randomly ordered counter speeches from the two methods, and ask the judges to individually evaluate the generation quality based on the following criteria: • Fluency (Flu.): Is the generation fluent, grammatical, and without unnecessary repetitions? • Persuasiveness (Per.): Is the text able to convince you to adopt a certain belief or attitude? • % of arguments addressed (% Arg.): Does the counter speech address all claims/arguments in the supporting speech?
